data: Which of the following datasets show a higher sequence accuracy for the Transformer Attention?

The question asks which dataset shows a higher sequence accuracy for the Transformer Attention. From the caption, we know that the figure represents the Sequence Accuracy (SeqAcc) for the Location Attender and the best baseline on the Long Lookup Tables task across five datasets. The bars in the figure represent the values for each dataset.

Looking at the figure, the blue bars represent the Location Attender, and the orange bars represent the Transformer Attention. The height of the bars indicates the sequence accuracy. By comparing the heights of the orange bars (Transformer Attention) with the blue bars (Location Attender), we can see that the orange bars are consistently lower than the blue bars across all datasets.

Therefore, none of the datasets show a higher sequence accuracy for the Transformer Attention compared to the Location Attender.
